disclaimer.title: Before We Begin… 🌸
disclaimer.subtitle: Just a few things to know about Kibun
disclaimer.body: Kibun is here to help you with self-reflection and mood tracking — think of it as a cozy journal companion! 📝

bullets.professionalCare: A substitute for professional mental health care

disclaimer.crisisBody: Please contact local emergency services or a licensed professional immediately. You matter. 💙
disclaimer.checkbox: I understand Kibun is for wellness only ✨
disclaimer.loginLink: Already have an account? Sign in and skip onboarding
disclaimer.personalizationNote: Heads up: these onboarding answers improve your summaries later.

firstMood.headline: How are you feeling?
firstMood.subline: Pick the mood that feels closest right now.

wisdomAwareness.headline: Naming what you feel is the first step.
wisdomAwareness.body: Simply naming an emotion can soften how it feels. The act of noticing is its own kind of care.

wisdomMindBody.headline: Your body keeps the score.
wisdomMindBody.body: Sleep, movement, and breath shape your mood as much as any thought you'll ever have. Caring for one cares for the other.

wisdomSmallShifts.headline: Big change rarely happens at once.
wisdomSmallShifts.body: Tiny moments of attention — even ten seconds a day — compound into real shifts over time. That's why we're here.
